leadText: This shopkeeper appears in Pokémon UNITE. She works at Aeos Emporium, a store that sells all manner of items to s participating in Unite Battles.
plainText:
This shopkeeper appears in Pokémon UNITE. She works at Aeos Emporium, a store that sells all manner of items to s participating in Unite Battles.

==In the games==
This character welcomes the player into Aeos Emporium, a generalist shop that sells every kind of item that does not fit the Unite Battle Committee and Zirco Trading shops. Her partner Pokémon is .

She also appears on the menu where the player is purchasing a Trainer fashion item from the Fashion tab of Aeos Emporium. (The Fashion Tab uses a special menu, so this does not occur for purchasing items from the Fashion Ticket Exchange tab.)

She also appears in the menu where the player manages their treasure chests in Treasure Chest Challenge events, behind the table with the treasure chests but in front of the screen displaying the possible rewards, and is posed such that she appears to be highlighting the screen.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon UNITE Manga - Come On Over to Aeos Island!===
This character appeared in the third chapter, Welcome to the Stadium!. She and her called over a trainer and their father to Aeos Emporium. The two took a look at the items on display, guided by the shopkeeper. Ultimately, the trainer purchased bags upon bags of items, as well as a new hoodie for herself.
